summary: The punished iron-ball throw reaches the source call to ball.c:drop_ball after dothrow.c:throwit lands and stacks the ball. That function moves the hero and chain behind the thrown ball when its landing square differs from the hero. JavaScript currently records note_unported('ball.c drop_ball') in throwit, so C moves the hero at step 48 while JS leaves the hero at the launch square. A second direct source caller is do.c:dropz; js/do.js contains the same unported callee marker.
selectionReason: Selected as the highest queue candidate available after excluding A2- and B-reserved v45 cases and the submitted leash case; the source trace identifies an unreserved ball.c:drop_ball owner.

source.branch: When the punished iron ball has already been placed at its landing square, drop_ball() updates blind ball/chain glyph order if needed. If the landing square differs from the hero, it releases eligible traps, moves the hero to the landing square or the adjacent square behind it, moves the chain, refreshes vision, and triggers spot effects after a real hero move.
callers: dothrow.c:throwit() calls drop_ball(gb.bhitpos.x, gb.bhitpos.y) for the landed uball at lines 1838-1841, after place_object()/stackobj() and before the final newsym().
do.c:dropz() calls drop_ball(u.ux, u.uy) at line 834 after place_object(), impact effects, and corpse disturbance, before stackobj()/newsym().

evidence: Saved queue SHA-256 9edb63a9a40e02e21bab96178737b56a53a8820b654e9ce5cb82375309f7ca4b identifies this as the unreserved 48/49-screen v45 case; the first mismatch is the step-48 screen and cursor after key j, with all 2900 RNG calls matched.

Read complete upstream ball.c:drop_ball() at lines 882-965. Its changed-square branch updates the hero coordinates, moves uchain, requests vision recalculation, and invokes spoteffects only after movement; its trapped branches include reset_utrap/fill_pit and source-ordered messages, sound, and injury.

Read upstream dothrow.c:throwit() at lines 1838-1841: after the thrown uball is placed and stacked, C calls drop_ball at the projectile landing square. Current js/dothrow.js:2882 uses note_unported('ball.c drop_ball') at the corresponding point.
Read upstream do.c:dropz() at line 834 and current js/do.js:2199-2202: the ordinary drop caller also calls the same C function after placement and effects; JavaScript records the same unported gap.

A bounded fresh C/JavaScript differential at the current task boundary reproduced the queue mismatch at boundary 49 / input step 48: C cell row 5 column 64 is the ball glyph and cursor [63,7,1], while JS still shows the hero and cursor [63,4,1]. PRNG lengths and all 2900 values match; animation frames also match.

The required trap.c:reset_utrap and trap.c:fill_pit helpers are already implemented in js/trap.js; drop_ball discards their void results. The active direct caller families are do.c:dropz and dothrow.c:throwit.
